--- text
[alpha] beta
--- keys
Cmd+C End Space Cmd+V
--- expect
alpha beta alpha|
--- note
Copy is a read, not a write. A non-empty selection copies character-wise, so
Cmd+C must leave both the document and the selected text untouched. End moves
the caret to the end of the line, Space appends one space, and pasting the
copied "alpha" inserts it there with the caret after the pasted run. The only
edits come from Space and the paste, never from the copy itself.
